data.current_description:
Record a payment for the transaction using the points.
This should be used when the consumer pays for the purchase.
The payment should be recorded before the transaction is finalised.

The amount should be based on the `available_credit` received from the GET `/account` endpoint.

This will lock the consumer's points, which will be debited from the account when the transaction is finalised.

The returned `payment_xref` should be sent in the `other_payments` array in the POST `/transaction/{transaction_id}/finalise` request.
It is considered an error if the payment is not included in `other_payments` if it has not been cancelled using the `/payment/{payment_xref}/cancel` endpoint beforehand.

The endpoint with return `Bad Request` if the points balance became insufficient in the meantime (e.g. consumer making a concurrent purchase)
data.summary_suggestion: Record points payment and lock consumer credit
data.description_suggestion: Records a points payment for the transaction in the pre-tender flow. Locks the consumer's available points credit for this purchase, which will be debited when the transaction is finalized. The payment amount must not exceed the `available_credit` from the GET `/account` endpoint. Returns a `payment_xref` that must be included in the `other_payments` array of the POST `/transaction/{transaction_id}/finalise` request. If the points balance becomes insufficient before finalization (e.g., concurrent purchase), returns `Bad Request`. The payment can be cancelled using POST `/transaction/{transaction_id}/payment/{payment_xref}/cancel` to unlock the points.

data.current_description:
Standard flow:
If a loyalty card has been scanned, include the `loyalty_id` and `program_id` in the loyalty array.
The program_id should be configured as a variable in the POS system.

Offline Flow:
This endpoint must also be used when the POS is offline and cannot retrieve member details from Go Rewards in real time.
Customers may still scan their loyalty card or provide a valid phone number.
Points will be attributed once the receipt is received by Go Rewards.

If a phone number is provided in offline mode:
Set `loyalty_id` to `"phone_number_provided"`.
Set the `purchaser` object's `"phone"` attribute to the provided phone number.

If the loyalty program is handled by Go Rewards, the points attribution will be performed downstream with loyalty $ discounts potentially be converted into additional points.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit receipt for post-tender loyalty processing
data.description_suggestion: Submits a receipt for post-tender loyalty processing and points attribution. Supports two flows: (1) Standard flow - include `loyalty_id` and `program_id` when a loyalty card has been scanned; (2) Offline flow - use when POS cannot retrieve member details in real-time. In offline mode with phone number, set `loyalty_id` to "phone_number_provided" and include the phone number in the `purchaser` object. If the loyalty program is managed by Go Rewards, points attribution and discount conversion to additional points occur downstream. Returns a receipt reference for tracking and future adjustments.
